services.name: Anchorage Whale
services.desc: A fin whale washed ashore in Anchorage and was left there for months. Then a self-described ‘wacko’ museum director made a plan When a whale dies, its body descends to the bottom of the deep sea in a transformative phenomenon called a whale fall. A whale’s death jump-starts an explosion of life, enough to feed and sustain a deep-ocean ecosystem for decades. There are a lot of ways whales can die. Migrating whales lose their way and, unable to find their way back from unfamiliar waters, are stranded. They can starve when prey disappears or fall to predators such as orcas. blurb: Located in Wasilla, the Museum of Alaska is a one-of-a-kind destination celebrating the state’s transportation, industrial, and cultural heritage. From vintage trains and early bush planes to our groundbreaking whale skeleton project, we offer an immersive experience for families, history lovers, and curious minds of all ages.
